raw_sections.awards: Achievements Mapped 12+ source-to-consumption systems and established 50+ Data Offerings and Data Contracts, strengthening regulatory traceability, ownership, and accountability. Developed governance documentation, metadata repositories, and change-management artifacts, sustaining 95%+ audit traceability across 4 Retail Services initiatives. Designed, validated, and implemented 700+ Data Quality Rules across 150+ CDEs, enabling early detection of 200+ potential data defects and shifting resolution to source-level correction. Remediated and dispositioned 100+ failed DQ rules through SQL-driven root cause analysis, reducing open data quality issues by approximately 20%. Improved data reliability across 15+ business-critical use cases while supporting regulatory reporting requirements including FR Y-14. Built Power BI and Excel dashboards tracking 700+ rules by status, pass/fail rate, and RAG, achieving approximately 90% disposition targets. CORE COMPETENCIES Data Governance & Stewardship Data Quality Management Data Issue Management & Remediation Data Controls, Control Review & Oversight Metadata Management & Data Cataloguing Data Lineage, Traceability & CDE Management Regulatory Compliance, BCBS 239 & Regulatory Reporting Data Profiling, Root Cause Analysis & Audit Readiness Stakeholder Management, Team Leadership & Governance Reporting TECHNICAL SKILLS Data Governance & Metadata: Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Data Contracts, Data Offerings, Data Stewardship, Data Ownership, CDE Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloguing, Metadata Documentation, Audit Traceability Data Analysis & Databases: SQL, Python, Data Profiling, Data Validation, Data Quality Rules, Data Quality Controls, Root Cause Analysis, Issue Remediation Project & Collaboration Tools: JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, MS Project Reporting & Visualization: Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio Frameworks & Standards: BCBS 239, DQCA / DQMRC Control Benchmark, Regulatory Reporting, Control Assessment, Issue Remediation Lifecycle

VAMSIVARDHAN MUKKANA Experienced Functional Business Analyst with end-to-end involvement in requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, business analysis, functional documentation, and solution delivery across Citi Bank's Capital Markets environment. Experienced working with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Business SMEs, Data Owners, and Technology stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into functional solutions and governance outcomes. +91 6300236605 mukkanavamsi@gmail.com vamsivardhan Bengaluru, Karnataka, India PROFILE SUMMARY Data Management Analyst with 4 years of BFSI experience, supporting a major U.S. bank on Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, and Regulatory Reporting initiatives. Experienced in Citi Bank's Capital Markets environment, supporting enterprise data governance, regulatory compliance, data quality, and data management initiatives. Strong Functional Business Analysis experience with end-to-end requirements gathering, collaborating with Business SMEs, Data Owners, Legal, Risk,

lineage, audit traceability, and regulatory reporting initiatives across Capital Markets / banking data portfolios. Defined Data Offerings, Data Contracts, Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data ownership models, governance controls, metadata repositories, and remediation frameworks. Designed and validated enterprise Data Quality Rules across Accuracy, Completeness, and Timeliness dimensions, performing SQL-based data profiling, root cause analysis, and issue of remediation. Collaborated with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Business SMEs, Data Owners, and Technology teams to understand regulatory and governance requirements and support implementation of appropriate data controls. Provided oversight across the issue of remediation lifecycle, validating corrective actions and closure evidence with Data Owners. Reviewed Data Quality Controls against the enterprise control benchmark (DQCA / DQMRC), evaluating control effectiveness, design coverage, and identifying control gaps. Collaborated with Data Owners, Use Case Owners, Technology teams, and Control Partners across sprint-based delivery,
reporting progress to senior leadership while leading a team of 7 members across 4 lending programs. Key
